main_body: sci-fi building with sloped metal roof and front wall
top_band: light blue-grey panelled roof slope with vents from row 1 to row 17
evidence: Row 0 is top outline; rows 1-16 show the foreshortened sloped roof surface with roof vents in 3/4 view; row 17 is a light grey front-edge trim; row 18 is a darker grey eave shadow above the orange trim (rows 19-20) and grey front wall (rows 21-44) which features inset windows and a recessed doorway.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, per-tile and per-stone textured Beodeul houses, the candidate uses large flat fills on the roof panels, wall panels, and windows with minimal speckle, fewer shading steps per material, and a heavy pure-black outline on the roof edges.
